=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:1211-1218, 1858-1877 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: On `orchestrator/project-*` integration sync, when the `.gitleaksignore` union resolves the last unmerged path, the commit is deferred with `_det_commit_scope="gitleaksignore-only"`. If another auto-merged file then fails the fingerprint check, the only hand-off (line 1866) covers `.ai-asset-only`, so this scope falls through to the bare `exit 1` at lines 1873-1876 before the resolver is dispatched.
  WHY: The run fails hard with no `ai:resolver-escalated` retry state, which is worse than before this PR. The tests in tests/test_conflict_gitleaksignore_union.py:444-455 lock in this abort. All three flagging reviewers rated it MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 checked it and did not carry it forward, because the issue requires parity with the `_ff_defer_commit` / `_mu_defer_commit` cases.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:675-688 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: `unblock_triage_superseded_note` treats every cached gate status other than resolved/already_resolved as "post the note and stop". That includes the terminal `not_triage` and `disabled` statuses, which exit 0 and are cached by `unblock_check_triage_resolved` (lines 555-557).
  WHY: An `ai:check-triage` issue with no trusted triage header gets one note and then stays `ai:blocked` forever through the `already_noted` `return 0`. No judge round is used, so the round budget and park/digest escalation never fire. This contradicts the README ("No gate verdict ... judges as before").
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:686 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The new `gh api` call that posts triage superseded notes triggers the `gh_api_write_guard`.
  WHY: The failing CI tests in `tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py` are cited as evidence that the call is not authorized or gated for this workflow, so the note is never posted. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash state these failures are not caused by this PR, and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash notes that the guard allowlists `POST issues/<n>/comments`.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:306-314 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `[ "${#gitleaks_suggest_lines[@]}" -lt 10 ] || break` at line 307 runs before the `gitleaks_suggest_missing` increment at lines 310-311. Once 10 suggestions are accepted, later candidates whose commit is absent from the shallow checkout are never counted.
  WHY: The log field `missing=<m>` is documented in the agents fragment as the full count of fingerprints whose commit is not in the shallow checkout, so it undercounts and hides the shallow-history drops it was added to show. All reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:683-695 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When the comment POST fails, `unblock_triage_superseded_note` logs `outcome=skip reason=comment_failed` but returns 0. The caller at line 2139 reads 0 as "this run must stop".
  WHY: The log contradicts the actual control flow. The end state is safe: the item stays blocked and the marker-once guard retries on the next run. All three rated it NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 also called the end state safe.
- (merge gate, not a code hunk):pre-push test gate summaries in the PR body | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The pre-push gate attributes failures in `tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py`, `tests/test_changelog_fragment_contract.py`, `tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py`, `tests/test_ai_label_precreation_contract.py`, `tests/test_review_autofix_provider_outage_contract.py::test_label_contract_and_reporter_skip` and `tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py` to this change, but none of them can be mapped to the PR diff.
  WHY: The gate reports fail and drives pointless repair turns while check-runs on head SHA cbcd5a4 show `failed_count: 0`. The tests should be re-run on the PR head and on the merge-base. Rated NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:unblock_triage_superseded_note, lines 675-681 (falls through to note ~688, `already_noted` ~683-686) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Every status other than resolved/already_resolved is treated as "post the note and stop". That includes `not_triage` (check_triage_resolution.py lines 1032-1035) and `disabled` (lines 1024-1026), both exit 0 and cached by `unblock_check_triage_resolved` (lines 555-557).
  WHY: The item gets one note and then stays `ai:blocked` forever. No judge round is used, so park/digest escalation never fires, which contradicts the README. Fix: return 1 unless `status` = `unverified` (~3 lines).
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:307 (before `missing` increment at 310-311) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The loop breaks after 10 accepted lines, so later unreachable candidates are not counted in `gitleaks_suggest_missing`.
  WHY: The log reports a smaller `missing` than the real number. Fix: skip the ancestry check after the cap but keep counting, or document the field as "missing among scanned candidates".
- HARDENING: scripts/unblock_judge.sh:unblock_triage_superseded_note `already_noted` branch (~683-686) | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
  PROBLEM: Even a genuine `unverified` verdict (for example, a linked PR closed without merging) keeps the item held on every run, with no expiry.
  WHY: Suggested fix: expire the note after `UNBLOCK_JUDGE_WAIT_MAX_DAYS*24` (default 14 days) through `unblock_hours_since`, then log `outcome=skip reason=note_expired` and return 1 (~6 lines).

  PROBLEM: After 10 accepted suggestions the loop breaks, and later candidates are never checked or counted. The Python preprocessor emits up to 200 candidates (line 346).
  WHY: `missing=N` understates the absent-commit count, which contradicts the documented contract.

  WHY: This is a log-only defect: the end state is correct, but the log is misleading. Fix: either log `outcome=noted reason=comment_failed` or return 1.
